registered_note: Registered before any E or RULA/REBA value of the M1 C1 runs was computed. Known at registration: the E1 results on the M2 arms (C0 residual 0.01 BW at every offset; W0 0.20/0.24/0.34, XFh 0.08/0.84/2.23, XFo 0.05/0.40/0.69, W0X 0.26/0.26/0.27 BW at offsets 0.1/0.5/1.0 m) and the E4 ARDY correction contrast under the native task path (REBA acceptable_lower -0.83).
question: Does ARDY's root correction carry a biomechanical and ergonomic cost when the waypoint target agrees with ARDY's own gait (its own uncorrected output plus a small offset), and how much of the cost grows with the target offset (target conflict) rather than being present at the smallest offset (mechanism cost)

data.source: M1 block of config/m1 (develop_logs/test_runs/20261031_m1), read only, no new generation

arms.C1: correction 1 with write-back, root_margin 0.04 m (official default)

data.offset_choice: the three E1 offsets, for comparability with E1; offsets 0.05/0.25/0.75 exist but are not evaluated (CPU budget)

pipeline: E1 pipeline (config/e1_biomech_20261101.json) with the global heading unclamped from the start (the E1y fix); RULA/REBA frames per config/ergo_rula_reba_20261105.json with object_free true
validity: E1 per-run rule; pipeline valid if the C0 cell-mean residual force RMS is <= 0.03 BW at every offset

primary.family: F1-F4, Holm at 0.05 over exact sign-flip p values on task means, two-sided; supported = Holm p < 0.05, cluster t interval excludes 0, pipeline valid (and, for F3/F4, C0 not insensitive by the ergo config rule)
primary.F1: C1 - C0 residual force RMS (BW) at offset 0.1 m
primary.F2: slope over offset of C1 - C0 residual force RMS: per task, least squares on the seed-mean differences at 0.1/0.5/1.0 m (BW per m)
primary.F3: C1 - C0 REBA acceptable_lower at offset 0.1 m
primary.F4: slope over offset of C1 - C0 REBA acceptable_lower (per m)
primary.pairs: task-seed-offset pairs with both runs valid

interpretation.mechanism_cost: F1 supported with C1 - C0 >= 0.05 BW, or F3 supported: the correction costs even when the target agrees with ARDY's own gait
interpretation.conflict_cost: F2 (positive) or F4 (negative) supported: the cost grows with the target offset
interpretation.e4_link: E4 used the native task path (0.4 m/s, reversing at 5 s), which conflicts with ARDY's own 0.64 m/s non-reversing gait; it is compared descriptively only (different tasks and targets)

secondary: per-offset C1 - C0 contrasts on residual force RMS, unsupported fraction, residual moment, joint moments, muscle effort, REBA four-class shares, RULA acceptable_lower
descriptive RULA/REBA levels of the E1 M2 arms (C0, W0, XFh, XFo, W0X) per offset
all-pairs sensitivity without the validity exclusion
storage: OpenSim files on the data disk (outputs/ardy_fair_20261105/runs); metrics under develop_logs/test_runs/20261105_ardy_fair/e; ergo rows under develop_logs/test_runs/20261105_ergo/m1
